subject: Trial coordination: success metrics, kickoff logistics, and final readout plan
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Saira Khan <saira.khan@magnetix.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps & success criteria — Redwood trial for Magnetix.ai

Saira — thanks again for the call this morning. Quietly summarizing so we have a single source of truth and can lock the kickoff for next week. Please skim and flag anything missing.

Summary of what we agreed:
- Objective: Validate Redwood inference for Magnetix.ai search reranking pipeline (latency and throughput at your 95th-percentile query mix).
- Success criteria (working draft):
  * Latency: P95 <= 120ms for 1-token warm calls and <= 300ms for 256-token generation under 50 concurrent sessions.
  * Throughput: sustain 400 inference requests/minute with <= 10% tail variance during a 30-minute steady-state run.
  * Cost proxy: per-request token cost estimate within 30% of current baseline on your staging RT.
  * Quality: top-5 rerank delta (NDCG@5) no worse than -0.02 vs current baseline on the seed eval set.
- Scope of the trial: 3 weeks (kickoff + 2 full testing weeks + readout).
- Deliverables: trial runbook, weekly dashboards, final readout deck with data and recommendation.

Proposed immediate next steps (action owners in parens):
1) Kickoff meeting — Thu 24 May, 11am PT (Jordan) — confirm duration 60m and attend: Magnetix POC lead + infra engineer, Redwood AE + Solutions Eng + Product PM.
2) Exchange network/credential requirements for private staging (Magnetix to share; Evan to own).
3) Redwood to share runbook and preliminary perf targets (Ben to upload runbook + checklist by Tue EOD).
4) Define the evaluation dataset and seed queries (Saira + Marissa to align by Tue).

Attachments I will drop to the shared Drive: trial-runbook-v1.pdf, network-reqs-checklist.docx, magnetix-success-metrics-draft.xlsx.

If that aligns, I’ll send a calendar invite and a short pre-kickoff checklist for the engs.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---
Redwood Inference — engineering-grade inference across hosted, dedicated, private

From: Saira Khan <saira.khan@magnetix.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Cho <evan.cho@magnetix.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-19T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps & success criteria — Redwood trial for Magnetix.ai

Jordan — this is great, thanks for the concise recap. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- We agree with the objective. For quality, instead of raw NDCG delta we'll use our in-house metric "ClickFit@5" (higher is better); pass threshold is change >= -0.015 vs baseline on the seed set.
- For latency: we have two representative query distributions (search vs. recommendation). Can we run the latency spec against both? We'll provide the distributions by Tue.
- For scope: can we add a short smoke run on Week 0 (pre-kickoff) to validate connectivity and credentials? Evan will own.

Action items from Magnetix:
- Evan: send network & staging credentials by Tue 5/21 EOD and confirm who will join the kickoff call.
- Saira: prepare seed query snapshots and the ClickFit eval harness link.

We’re flexible on dates; Thu 24 May 11am PT works for us. Looking forward to the runbook.

Thanks —
Saira Khan
Head of ML Platforms | Magnetix.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Saira Khan <saira.khan@magnetix.ai>, Evan Cho <evan.cho@magnetix.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-20T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps & success criteria — Redwood trial for Magnetix.ai

Folks — attaching the first draft of the runbook and a short checklist for pre-kickoff smoke tests. High-level notes:
- runbook highlights: environment matrix, test vectors, scheduled steady-state runs (2x90m), and data capture hooks for latency and KV cache hit rates.
- network checklist: we’ll need open egress to our staging endpoints on ports 443 and 8443 and allow the Redwood agent to upload logs to the Drive link; full list in network-reqs-checklist.docx (attached).
- measurement: we’ll run both distributions Saira mentioned and emit combined and per-distribution P50/P95/P99.

Attaching:
- trial-runbook-v1.pdf (detailed steps + metrics dashboard template)
- network-reqs-checklist.docx (ports, IPs, certs)
- magnetix-success-metrics-draft.xlsx (spreadsheet with thresholds — editable)

Open questions for the kickoff agenda (Jordan, please confirm):
1) Who on Magnetix side owns the data export for the seed eval set?
2) Any limitations on sharing a small anonymized sample with Redwood for local testing?

I’ll be on the kickoff to walk through the steady-state tests and answer infra questions.

— Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Saira Khan <saira.khan@magnetix.ai>, Evan Cho <evan.cho@magnetix.ai>
Date: 2027-05-26T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed kickoff + owners for Magnetix trial (calendar invite sent)

Quick coordination internal -> external. I booked the 60m kickoff for Thu 24 May, 11:00–12:00 PT and updated the agenda in the event (link above). Jammed notes below so everyone knows owners before the call:

Agenda (60m):
- 5m: Introductions and objectives (Jordan + Saira)
- 10m: Trial scope & timeline (Jordan)
- 15m: Technical runbook walkthrough (Ben)
- 10m: Magnetix infra & network notes (Evan)
- 10m: Evaluation plan & success metrics (Marissa + Saira)
- 10m: Next steps & communications cadence (Jordan)

Owners and immediate pre-kickoff tasks: 
- Jordan (AE): calendar, meeting facilitation, commercial notes and final readout coordination.
- Ben (SRE/SE): runbook lead, steady-state test owner, attach dashboards to Drive.
- Marissa (CS): evaluation criteria custodian, readout story and business metrics.
- Laura (Legal contact): ready to scan any pre-kickoff NDA redlines (no DocuSign yet).
- Magnetix (Saira + Evan): provide seed eval snapshots and network creds by Tue 5/21.

Pre-kickoff smoke window: Wed 23 May 10:00–11:00 PT — Ben will be available to validate connectivity if Magnetix can provision the staging endpoints by Tue evening.

Follow-ups I’ll take after the call: upload final runbook v1.1, create weekly dashboard access, and schedule the 2-week steady-state window (Week 1 + Week 2).

If anyone needs different owners or timeline tweaks, reply-all and I’ll update the drive doc and calendar invite.

Thanks — see you on Thu,
Jordan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
